instruction: Build a TypeScript Fastify API with type providers and proper async patterns
relevant_when: Agent builds a Fastify API with TypeScript
context: Proactively check that the agent uses Fastify's TypeScript features correctly: type providers for schema-to-type inference, as const on schemas, proper async handler patterns (return vs reply.send), and correct module augmentation for decorators.

checklist.name: type-provider-configured
checklist.rule: Agent configures a Fastify type provider (JsonSchemaToTsProvider or TypeBoxTypeProvider) using app.withTypeProvider() so schemas automatically infer request/response types
checklist.relevant_when: Agent creates a Fastify app with TypeScript

checklist.name: as-const-on-schemas
checklist.rule: JSON Schema objects use 'as const' assertion so TypeScript can infer literal types from the schema definition
checklist.relevant_when: Agent defines JSON Schema for Fastify routes in TypeScript

checklist.name: no-type-casting-request
checklist.rule: Agent does not cast request.body, request.params, or request.query with 'as any' or manual type assertions -- types should flow from the schema via the type provider
checklist.relevant_when: Agent accesses request properties in typed Fastify handlers

checklist.name: async-handlers-correct
checklist.rule: Async route handlers either return a value (preferred) or call reply.send() but never do both. No fire-and-forget promises without await inside handlers

checklist.name: fastify-module-declarations
checklist.rule: Custom decorators on FastifyInstance or FastifyRequest are typed via 'declare module fastify' interface augmentation
checklist.relevant_when: Agent adds decorators to Fastify in TypeScript

checklist.name: plugin-typed-correctly
checklist.rule: Plugins use the FastifyPluginAsync type (or FastifyPluginCallback) from the fastify package for their function signature
checklist.relevant_when: Agent writes Fastify plugins in TypeScript
